By eye, the sand ramp has about 2-3 steps and the water about 2, well short of the 5-6 steps in the Beodeul grass and paving. The water body reads as a largely flat fill with little grain, ripple or speckle. The sand edge has no per-grain shading and no scattered dots like the reference's grass tufts and stone-by-stone shading. Even so, the shallow ramps and flat water interior make the piece look thinner and simpler than the reference next to it, so it fails.
